case.pattern_description: Although the transaction occurred in-person without matching standard remote or regional fraud patterns, the customer explicitly denied making the purchase.
case.summary: Case HHG-003 was confirmed as fraud with an 85 percent probability and a financial exposure of 49 dollars. The customer directly reported the transaction as unauthorized at intake, which takes precedence over automated patterns. Based on this customer denial, the card was blocked at level one. Transaction details and the card timeline were reviewed, confirming no prior similar cases.
